evidence.title: GitHub - huozhi/sugar-high: Super lightweight code syntax highlighter solution

name: Sugar High
summary: Lightweight syntax highlighter that turns code into HTML: 32 built-in languages, React Code/Editor components, themes and a remark plugin.
description: Sugar High highlights code into HTML in browsers and JavaScript runtimes without a DOM. The core package is 1.74 KB gzipped and covers 32 languages out of the box; @sugar-high/react adds Code and Editor components with built-in themes, @sugar-high/remark highlights markdown code blocks, and a client-side /capture tool renders shareable code screenshots. Theme tokens are scoped CSS variables with a Tailwind theme guide, and an agent skill teaches coding assistants the API.
contains: 32 built-in languages; JavaScript and JSX by default
1.74 KB core and 8.6 KB full, gzipped
@sugar-high/react Code and Editor components with built-in themes
remark plugin for markdown code blocks
theme tokens as scoped CSS variables; Tailwind theme guide
client-side /capture screenshot tool with state in the URL fragment
agent skill installable via npx skills add huozhi/sugar-high
